location_note: Shop in Suq al-Fakhir by the Seventh Station of the Via Dolorosa, Old City; no map reference found. Placed by the title name Jerusalem (Z4).
notes: Phase b hall with soap-making ovens and hydraulic-plastered vats (L119-L126); industrial vats not coded as pools (choice C5). Plastered channel L114 against W4 in the same phase is coded.
